packages.name: eslint-plugin-sonarjs
packages.reason: Code-checking tool used only during development; never shipped inside MeetApp, so its license has no effect on our code.

packages.name: @sonarsource/analyzer-commons-configurations
packages.reason: Part of eslint-plugin-sonarjs (development-only code checker); never shipped.

packages.name: sentry
packages.reason: Sentry's command-line helper, pulled in by the crash-reporting library. The license only forbids building a product that competes with Sentry; MeetApp doesn't. Each version becomes Apache-2.0 after two years. No duty to share our code.

packages.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64
packages.reason: Image engine (libvips) inside sharp, which re-encodes profile photos on the backend (F01, D049). An unchanged, separate library file that runs only on our server and is never shipped to users. The LGPL only asks to share changes to libvips itself, never MeetApp's code. One entry per computer type.
